which_endpoint: OS in PD-L1-positive population (first in the hierarchy; mITT not formally tested)
search_notes: IMpassion132 primary analysis at ESMO Breast Cancer 2024 (15-17 May 2024); OncLive coverage dated 15 May 2024 opened: OS in PD-L1+ HR 0.93 (0.73-1.20), p=0.59; mITT HR 0.94 (0.76-1.18). Annals of Oncology paper e-published the same day (PMID 38755096, doi 10.1016/j.annonc.2024.04.001). Roche quarterly results presentations checked for an earlier line: FY2023 (1 Feb 2024) and Q1 2024 (24 Apr 2024) list the trial with only 'FPI Q1 2018' and no result; it is absent from HY2024 (25 Jul 2024). No Roche release found. Registry primary completion date (Oct 2024) is five months after the readout.

FERMATA (BCD-100 is prolgolimab): no result found. One web search (acronym, BCD-100-5, prolgolimab cervical), PubMed (no hits for prolgolimab cervical cancer), Crossref (only the phase 2 CAESURA abstract, ASCO 2023) and the Biocad trial page (ct.biocad.ru, no status or results). Registry not updated since Sept 2020 (status unknown). Biocad news site is script-rendered and was not readable; Russian-language press not searched (web search budget ran out), so a Russian-only disclosure cannot be ruled out.

SHR-1701 is retlirafusp alfa. No result found: one web search (SHR-1701-III-310, retlirafusp alfa + bevacizumab NSCLC), Hengrui website news list to Oct 2026 (only the Oct 2021 trial approval for SHR-1701 + bevacizumab in NSCLC; later SHR-1701 items are other indications). Registry not updated since Nov 2021 (status unknown). Hengrui exchange notices have generic titles and were not read one by one; light search.

which_endpoint: PFS by IRC (dual primary with OS; OS not significant at this analysis)
search_notes: CHIPRO, ASCO 2026 LBA5504; OncLive article dated 29 May 2026 opened: PFS by IRC HR 0.427 (0.34-0.54), p<0.001; OS HR 0.932 (0.73-1.20), p=0.583; data cutoff 29 Jul 2025. Recorded met on one of two dual primaries (OS missed so far); whether PFS alone suffices under the protocol was not confirmed. Checked for an earlier company line: Chipscreen (SSE 688321) reply to an exchange inquiry dated Sept 2025 says the trial was 'waiting for the primary events', the 2025 annual report (31 Mar 2026, cninfo) says the phase 3 is 'ongoing', and no SSE/cninfo notice on chiauranib ovarian cancer was filed between Jul 2025 and Oct 2026. Registry still 'recruiting' with an estimated date.

PSMAddition: Novartis release of 2 Jun 2025, met rPFS at a prespecified interim analysis, no numbers. Novartis Q1 2025 results release (6-K, 29 Apr 2025) checked: no mention of PSMAddition. HR 0.72 (0.58-0.90) in the Novartis release of 19 Oct 2025 (ESMO 2025 Presidential Symposium); Lancet paper (PMID 42561994, doi 10.1016/S0140-6736(26)01092-5) gives the same HR, p=0.0021, second interim analysis with data cutoff 13 Jan 2025, which is the registry primary completion date.

which_endpoint: OS (Part 2: cemiplimab + platinum doublet vs placebo + platinum doublet)
search_notes: EMPOWER-Lung 3 (acronym not in registry). Sanofi/Regeneron release of 5 Aug 2021: trial stopped early on IDMC recommendation at a protocol-specified interim analysis after meeting OS; HR 0.71 (0.53-0.93), p=0.014, mOS 22 vs 13 mo, n=466. Read in a reposted copy (1stOncology); the Regeneron and Sanofi pages return 403/404 and Pharmafile coverage is dated 6 Aug 2021. The registry lists two primaries (Part 1 OS, Part 2 OS); the release covers the cemiplimab + chemotherapy comparison only and nothing was found on a separate Part 1 (ipilimumab-containing) analysis. Registry primary completion date (Feb 2025) is 3.5 years after the readout.

ASCERTAIN not read out. Asieris (SSE 688176) notice of 5 Feb 2024 on the sibling APL-1202 + chemotherapy trial (which failed) says ASCERTAIN was still enrolling and that 'existing data show a similar recurrence-free proportion' in the APL-1202 and epirubicin arms, with the development strategy under review; the 2024 half-year and annual reports repeat that line and say recruitment continues; the 2025 annual report (18 Apr 2026, cninfo) still lists the single-agent phase 3 as in progress. No EFS analysis, no termination notice in SSE/cninfo titles Jun 2023 to Oct 2026. Registry not updated since Feb 2022. The descriptive interim remark is not a primary analysis.

DIRECT (NanoKnife IRE): no result found. One web search (acronym, AngioDynamics, NanoKnife stage III pancreatic), AngioDynamics Q4 FY2026 release (8-K, 14 Jul 2026) and the FY2026 10-K (first 100k characters): no mention of DIRECT. Registry last updated Feb 2025, active not recruiting, estimated date. 8-K of 8 Oct 2026 and conference abstracts not checked.

which_endpoint: PFS by investigator (dual primary with OS; OS immature, no trend)
search_notes: IMbrave152/SKYSCRAPER-14: one line in the pipeline appendix of Roche's HY2025 results presentation (24 Jul 2025, PDF downloaded and read): 'Primary endpoint of PFS not met Q2 2025. OS was not mature at this time, but no trend of OS benefit was observed.' The Q1 2025 presentation (24 Apr 2025) shows only recruitment status. No stand-alone Roche release. HR 0.97 (0.8-1.2), p=0.7464 at ESMO 2025 LBA50 (OncLive, 19 Oct 2025).

SURTORI-01 (acronym not in registry): no result and no termination statement found. HUTCHMED results announcements read on EDGAR: FY2023 (28 Feb 2024) and 2024 interim (31 Jul 2024) list 'SURTORI-01: 2L NEC, phase III, ongoing since 2021'; FY2024 (19 Mar 2025), 2025 interim (7 Aug 2025) and FY2025 (5 Mar 2026) no longer mention the trial at all (first 100k characters of each read). A silent removal from the pipeline between Aug 2024 and Mar 2025, reason not stated; could be a quiet termination or a failed analysis. Registry not updated since Dec 2023. Web search for a notice was limited to one query.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR and OS (both primary endpoints reported met)
search_notes: Hengrui SSE notice 2025-158 dated 30 Sep 2025 (read in Gelonghui copy of 30 Sep 2025 and in Shanghai Securities News of 9 Oct 2025): NMPA accepted the first-line cervical cancer application for camrelizumab + famitinib; the phase 3 (443 patients, 45 centres, vs platinum chemotherapy) 'reached the prespecified primary endpoint in July 2025', PFS and OS significantly prolonged; no numbers and no protocol number in the notice. Protocol number SHR-1210-III-329 confirmed in Hengrui's ESMO article (24 Oct 2025): ESMO 2025 LBA38 presented 19 Oct 2025, PFS by BICR HR 0.68 (0.53-0.86), p=0.0007; OS HR 0.65 (0.49-0.86), p=0.0012; cutoff 10 Jun 2025. Hengrui's 2025 half-year report (Aug 2025) was not checked for an earlier line.

Orelabrutinib + R-CHOP in untreated MCL: registry shows completed with 3 patients enrolled (actual) of a planned phase 3, so no primary PFS analysis is possible. InnoCare's FY2023 results (HKEX, 28 Mar 2024) already describe a different first-line MCL phase 3 (orelabrutinib + BR vs BR, global), and FY2025 results (25 Mar 2026) list only that one. No notice explaining the stop was found; reason inferred, not stated.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR (sotorasib 960 mg and 240 mg + panitumumab, each vs investigator choice)
search_notes: CodeBreaK 300: first stated in Amgen's Q2 2023 results release (8-K exhibit 99.1, 3 Aug 2023): the study 'met its primary endpoint of PFS for both the 240 mg and 960 mg doses', no numbers; no stand-alone topline release. Amgen's 16 Oct 2023 ESMO preview gives no result. HR at ESMO 2023 LBA10 with NEJM e-publication on 22 Oct 2023 (PMID 37870968, doi 10.1056/NEJMoa2308795): 960 mg HR 0.49 (0.30-0.80), p=0.006; 240 mg HR 0.58 (0.36-0.93), p=0.03 (numbers read in ASCO Post, 30 Oct 2023). HR cells hold the 960 mg arm. Registry primary completion date (Jul 2025) is two years after the readout.

KarMMa-9: enrolment discontinued. 2seventy bio Q3 2024 release (8-K, 12 Nov 2024): with sponsor BMS it 'has discontinued enrollment' in KarMMa-9 following a September 2024 decision, cited for cost savings; no efficacy data. Registry shows 79 enrolled (actual) of a much larger planned trial, active not recruiting, primary completion 11 Aug 2025 (actual). No PFS analysis reported in later 2seventy releases (Feb, Mar 2025); BMS materials not read.

which_endpoint: OS and PFS by BICR (dual primary; both met)
search_notes: TROPION-Breast02: Daiichi Sankyo/AstraZeneca topline release of 6 Oct 2025 (Daiichi PDF opened): statistically significant improvement in both dual primaries, no numbers. ESMO 2025 release of 19 Oct 2025: OS HR 0.79 (0.64-0.98), p=0.0291; PFS by BICR HR 0.57 (0.47-0.69), p<0.0001. HR cells hold OS. AstraZeneca's own release page was not found (guessed URL 404); its H1 2025 results (Jul 2025) predate the registry completion date and were not read.

which_endpoint: PFS by IRC (dual primary with OS; first interim analysis; OS trend only)
search_notes: KN026-001 (later KC-WISE; KN026 is anbenitamab): Alphamab Oncology HKEX voluntary announcement of 30 Apr 2025 (CSPC, parent of JMT-Bio, filed the same day): Part 2 randomised phase 3 met PFS at the first interim analysis per IDMC, OS trend, no numbers. HR in the HKEX announcement of 17 Oct 2025 on the ESMO 2025 LBA: PFS HR 0.25 (p=5.44e-12, no CI given), OS HR 0.29 (not mature); cutoff 3 Apr 2025. Registry still 'recruiting', last updated Dec 2023, estimated date Nov 2025.

DATE IS LATE BY ABOUT TWO MONTHS. DP303c vs T-DM1 was presented at SABCS 2025 (December 2025) as late-breaking rapid-fire abstract RF6-03; no dated source for the session could be opened, so the row carries the Crossref deposit date of the published abstract (Clin Cancer Res supplement, doi 10.1158/1557-3265.SABCS25-RF6-03, 17 Feb 2026; AACR page returns 403, abstract text read from the Crossref record): interim analysis, cutoff 8 Jul 2025, BIRC PFS 8.8 vs 5.8 mo, stratified HR 0.56 (0.42-0.75), p<0.0001; OS immature. CSPC FY2025 results (HKEX, 25 Mar 2026) confirm the SABCS presentation and a clinical study report completed in Nov 2025; CSPC issued no stand-alone HKEX announcement (titles Jun 2024 to Oct 2026 checked), and its 2025 interim results (22 Aug 2025) report only last patient enrolled in Apr 2025. Matched by design (448 randomised from 28 Mar 2024), not by registry number.

AK105-303 (penpulimab vs chemotherapy, cHL, 60 patients): no result found. Akeso English news index (12 pages, to Sept 2026) has no Hodgkin item; PubMed/Crossref nothing. Registry not updated since Feb 2022. Light search: no web search, Akeso HKEX results announcements not read.

SHR-A1811 is trastuzumab rezetecan. No result found for the first-line HER2-mutant NSCLC phase 3: Hengrui website news list to Oct 2026 has phase 3 'met primary endpoint' items for other SHR-A1811 trials (HER2+ breast, Sept 2026) but none for HER2-mutant NSCLC; registry updated Jan 2026, still recruiting. Hengrui exchange notices carry generic titles and were not read one by one; no web search.

JSKN003-302 not read out. Alphamab Oncology HKEX announcements Jan 2025 to Oct 2026 (titles) contain no JSKN003-302 result, and the 2026 interim results (27 Aug 2026) still list JSKN003 in >=2L HER2-low breast cancer as a phase 3 programme with no readout. Registry recruiting, estimated date.

which_endpoint: PFS and OS in the RAS G12-mutant population (dual primary; first interim analysis, declared final)
search_notes: RASolute 302: Revolution Medicines 8-K of 13 Apr 2026: statistically significant improvement in PFS and OS at the first interim analysis, results final; the only number is OS in the overall population (13.2 vs 6.7 mo, HR 0.40, p<0.0001, no CI), which is not the registry primary population, so hr_in_first_disclosure = no. NEJM paper e-published 31 May 2026 (PMID 42223072, doi 10.1056/NEJMoa2605555; abstract read): G12 population OS HR 0.40 and PFS HR 0.45, both p<0.001, no CIs in the abstract. HR cells hold OS in the G12 population. Company press-release page returns 403; 8-K text read instead.

which_endpoint: PFS (dual primary with OS; prespecified interim analysis; OS immature)
search_notes: SKB264 is sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT); the trial is OptiTROP-Breast03. Kelun-Biotech release of 21 May 2026: IDMC found PFS met at a prespecified interim analysis, OS immature with a positive trend, no numbers. Matched by design, not registry number: first-line TNBC, PD-L1-negative or PD-L1-positive relapsed after early-stage anti-PD-(L)1, vs investigator-choice chemotherapy, PFS and OS primaries, exactly as the registry record. NMPA accepted the first-line TNBC application on 30 Jul 2026 (Kelun news list). No HR found yet. Kelun's HKEX filing of the same news was not opened and may be dated a day earlier.

SSGJ-707 (PD-1/VEGF bispecific, licensed to Pfizer as PF-08634404) vs pembrolizumab: no result found. 3SBio HKEX announcement titles May 2025 to Oct 2026 show only the Pfizer licence; 2026 interim results (20 Aug 2026) give no readout. Trial registered in 2025 with an estimated date of Jul 2026. Light search: no web search, Pfizer materials not read.

FDA018-ADC (F0024, Trop2-SN38 ADC) phase 3 not read out. Fudan-Zhangjiang 2026 interim results (HKEX, 14 Aug 2026): follow-up and data collection 'progressed as planned' and the company is preparing the marketing application, with no result stated; HKEX English and Chinese titles to 9 Oct 2026 show no result notice. PubMed has only the phase 1 paper. Registry estimated date 18 Aug 2026.

CIBI308G301 (perioperative sintilimab, resectable NSCLC): no result found. Innovent HKEX announcement titles Jun 2025 to Oct 2026 have nothing on it; 2026 interim results (25 Aug 2026) say only that phase 3 studies of sintilimab 'including as perioperative therapy of NSCLC' are ongoing or planned. PubMed nothing. Registry active not recruiting, estimated date 30 Sep 2026.

BL-M07D1 is T-Bren (HER2 ADC). Not read out: Sichuan Biokin (SSE 688506) announcement titles Jan 2025 to 30 Sep 2026 include 'interim analysis met primary endpoint' notices for five iza-bren (BL-B01D1) phase 3 trials but none for BL-M07D1 vs T-DM1; the Hong Kong prospectus of 7 Nov 2025 describes T-Bren as in phase 3 for HER2+ breast cancer without a result. PubMed/Crossref nothing. Registry (Jul 2026) active not recruiting, 274 enrolled, estimated date Oct 2026.
